mode.heading: How do you want to work?
mode.subheading: You can change this later, project by project.
mode.local.title: Create a project here
mode.local.desc: Files stay here. The people you invite connect to it, from one computer to another.
mode.local.close: unavailable if you’re the only one
mode.join.title: Join a project
mode.join.desc: Paste the link you received. Same idea: computer to computer, no server.
mode.server.title: ReView server
mode.server.desc: Connect to your studio’s server. Just like a browser.
mode.serverInstall: A ReView server can also be installed on a studio machine.
connect.heading: Connect to a ReView server
connect.recap: Nothing you open is written to this disk: the server window is private and forgets everything when it closes. Only the server address is kept, once the connection succeeds.
connect.label: Server address
connect.plainHttp: http:// address: the connection is not encrypted. Keep it to the studio’s local network.
error.addressScheme: Only http:// and https:// addresses are accepted.
error.addressCredentials: Don’t put a user name or password in the address: you’ll sign in inside the server window.
error.unreachable: Server unreachable. Check the address, your connection or the studio VPN.
error.timeout: The server did not answer in time.
error.tls: Secure connection failed: this computer doesn’t recognise the server’s certificate, or the server doesn’t use HTTPS (then try its http:// address).
error.notReview: A server answers at this address, but it is not a ReView server.
error.httpStatus: The server answered with an error ({status}).
error.store: The server list could not be saved.
error.window: The server window could not be opened.
servers.heading: Your servers
servers.lead: Each server opens in its own private window: you sign in every time you open it.
servers.otherModes: See the other ways to work
window.serverBadge: ReView server · nothing on this disk
